name: IRLNEP Habitat Restoration Projects RFP

funder.name: Indian River Lagoon Council (Indian River Lagoon National Estuary Program)

summary: Local funding for on-the-ground habitat restoration in Florida's Indian River Lagoon, such as seagrass, oyster and other filter-feeder restoration, living shorelines, and design and engineering of restoration sites. Nonprofits can apply on their own.
reporting: Funded projects submit quarterly progress reports from the first quarter after contract execution until the project is complete.

status.quote: Category 2: Habitat Restoration Projects Open from October 15, 2026

opens.quote: Proposal packages will be accepted beginning on October 15, 2026, and are due by Monday December 14, 2026, by 5:00 p.m.

deadline.quote: Proposal packages will be accepted beginning on October 15, 2026, and are due by Monday December 14, 2026, by 5:00 p.m.

applicant_types.quote: The Applicant must be a public agency or not-for profit organization

geography.quote: IRL Council funds may be used for projects within the formal IRLNEP watershed boundary (Ponce de Leon Inlet, Volusia County to Jupiter Inlet, Palm Beach County)

access.quote: Proposal packages will be accepted beginning on October 15, 2026, and are due by Monday December 14, 2026, by 5:00 p.m.

window.quote: Proposal packages will be accepted beginning on October 15, 2026, and are due by Monday December 14, 2026, by 5:00 p.m.

amount.quote: Applicants can request a minimum of $25,000 up to $100,000.

pool.quote: In FY 2028 approximately $100,000 is expected to be available for habitat restoration projects.

co_finance_required.quote: Habitat restoration projects must demonstrate a minimum cost-share match of 50% of the total project cost of the project being proposed.

reporting.quote: The recipient shall submit quarterly progress reports starting after the first quarter following contract execution and continuing to project completion.
